statement: The project owner requires each learning target’s “What to notice” to identify a concrete observable cue in the raw post, not an absence or unsupported negative such as “There is no proof.” The owner reversed the Nintendo KP5 removal decision: retain all five knowledge points, including KP5 with its original content. Nintendo KP3’s observation must read exactly: “The post is not from an official Nintendo account but someone named Lucy Simms”. This supersedes the earlier removal decision; do not automatically remove KP5 based on the general observable-cue guidance. The cue rule also applies under the canonical “Observation task” label. Author final task labels directly in the source catalog and pass target text unchanged into prompts; do not rewrite target expressions at request time.

include: Reviewing and writing scenario learning targets
exclude: Prohibiting protective negative instructions in What to do, such as do not click
Automatically removing points in other templates without their individual review

lifecycle.sunset_condition: The project owner explicitly revises this guidance.
